newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Zagrebacka up after losses.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Zagrebacka up after losses.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Friday on dwindling volume and turnover, as market heavyweight Zagrebacka Banka rebounded to its support point of 2,000 kuna.
* Seven of 17 active issues rose, six fell and four were flat.
* Volume halved at 6,433 shares, turnover more than three times lower at 4.8 million kuna.
* Top gainer Karlovacka Banka's 2C series gained 10 kuna to 260 on volume 1,300, in a first deal since March 6.
* Biggest loser electric manufacturer Koncar fell 65 kuna to 1,200, selling 17 shares.
* Most active food processor Podravka inched down 0.50 kuna to 279.50 nkuna on volume of 1,587 units. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
